name: Send a Slack message for every post Nadia publishes

parameters.content:
## Tell your team in Slack every time a post goes live

> **Self-hosted n8n only.** This template uses the `n8n-nodes-nadia` community node, which n8n has not verified yet. Install it first: Settings -> Community Nodes -> Install -> `n8n-nodes-nadia`.

Nadia publishes on a schedule, so posts go out while nobody is watching. This workflow turns each publication into one Slack message with the channel, the text and a link, so the team sees what the account said without opening the app.

The **Nadia Trigger** registers its own webhook when you activate the workflow and removes it when you deactivate it. There is nothing to configure inside Nadia.

### How it works

1. **On published post** receives a signed `post.published` delivery.
2. **Shape the message** flattens the envelope into the fields the message needs.
3. **Post to Slack** sends it to the channel of your choice.

### Setup

1. Add your **Nadia** credential: API key from Settings -> Developers in Nadia, host `https://app.usenadia.com/api`.
2. Add your **Slack** credential to **Post to Slack** and pick a channel.
3. Activate the workflow: the trigger registers the webhook at that moment. n8n must be reachable from the internet over HTTPS.

### Customize

Pick channels on the trigger to watch only some accounts, or add `automation.triggered` to also hear about comment automations that fired.

## The webhook registers itself
Activate the workflow and Nadia starts delivering. Deactivate it and the webhook is removed.

## One readable message
The envelope is flattened and the HTML of the post turned into plain text before it reaches Slack.
